title: ★ Cabin style Oasis in the city★10 mins - Downtown
description:
Our private guest house is located on a beautiful piece of land in East Nashville.  This private cabin feels like you are in the country but with all the urban convenience of the city.  It is walking distance to a independent cafe and a bar/lounge up the road. East Nashville is a convenient distance to all the great things Nashville has to offer. 10 minute drive from Downtown too!  There is a grocery store 1 mile away.  We look forward to your stay and are eager to make it a comfortable one.

The space
Our space was built to feel like a boutique cabin but with modern sleek amenities:
Amenities:
- 24 hour keyless access with personal key code
- King and Queen beds
- Private Parking spot off street
- Fast and reliable Fiber WIFI
- Fully Equipped wet Bar with Microwave, toaster, coffee 
   maker and mini fridge
- Roku Smart TV 
- Private, entrance and courtyard seating
- Filtered Water and French press with complimentary coffee 
   grounds
- Luxury bath towels
- Iron
- Blow dryer
- Shampoo, conditioner and body wash

Guest access
Guest have access to the guest house plus side courtyard.

Other things to note
*6% plus $2.50 a night for Hotel taxes are collected- look at house rules for more details
